name: Feature list over a dark field
looks: On a dark field a six-item feature list stacks down the frame one line per beat, each new item landing white while earlier items settle to a dim grey, until the whole list is visible and the last item stays bright. The frame then hard-cuts to a single bold two-word payoff line lower on the frame.
build: List-stack-reveal with six lines instead of three, a faster per-line beat (about 0.22s) so the longer list still lands inside a few seconds; the payoff line enters after a short hold with its own fade/slide-up.
sound: A steady tick per item, faster than the three-line version, with a settling beat before the payoff line's tick.
prompt: List five or six concrete options a feature supports, one per beat, stacking down a dark field with earlier items dimming as each new one lands and the last one staying bright. Follow with a short, bold line that names the single idea tying the list together.
